name: Marburger Orchard
description: Marburger Orchard is a small orchard in Fredericksburg, TX. It grows Peaches, Figs, Squash, Corn, and Tomatoes, with picking through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
